analysis.primary_quality: unweighted macro mean across the three dataset-native metrics
report: paired percentile-bootstrap 95% intervals for react minus nexus
calls, token categories, dollars, median latency, and p95 latency

transfer_criterion.cost: nexus mean effective USD per example <= react
transfer_criterion.unique_successes: nexus-only exact successes >= react-only exact successes
transfer_criterion.workflow_calls: nexus mean calls per example < react

artifact_hashes.status: verified before calls; values omitted for double-blind review

budget.empirical_basis: Existing 150 primary-development rows used only for aggregate token/call cost planning; no outcomes used for item selection or tuning.
budget.planning_maximum_method: More than ten times the prior-development token-profile estimate at the frozen endpoint prices; every logical call is also pre-reserved from the USD 15 ledger.

replication_description: Prospectively frozen and publicly timestamped branch-comparison replication; not a preregistration and not selector tuning.

selection.convfinqa: one seeded turn from each of 25 distinct dialogues absent from both prior partitions
selection.finqa: seeded sample outside both prior partitions
selection.tatqa: seeded proportional question_type x answer_from sample outside both prior partitions

stop_immediately_on: dataset drift, reserved-partition overlap, or runtime target-metadata leakage
any need to change the prospectively frozen plan

workflows.nexus: deterministic structured search with one frozen adjudication prompt
workflows.react: bounded Search/Lookup/Finish ReAct using the frozen prompt
